reviews.text: The only board and train we would ever trust! Gabriel helped set us up shortly after bringing home our first puppy. Ralph was overwhelmed on walks, and would constantly “plop”. Living in Brooklyn, we wanted to make sure Ralph could walk with us in our neighborhood. After the board and train, Ralph is walking up to a mile without stopping, and most notably, is now a confident dog. His overall manners improved as well!! Gabriel also trained us (we needed more training than Ralph!).

We reached out to Gabriel when we were looking for some extra help with Otis after our baby arrived. We started with a few sessions at home and decided to do a 10-day board & train after seeing how well Otis responded to Gabriel.

Gabriel worked with Otis on recall, leash reactivity, his tendency to get overly excited when guests come to the door, and more. He sent us videos every day while Otis was with him so we could see what they were working on, and we’ve seen such a noticeable improvement since he came home.

I also really appreciated that Gabriel walked us through how to continue working with Otis at home so we could build on the progress he made while he was away. We’re really happy with the experience and the difference we’ve seen in Otis's behavior. We definitely recommend Pawmos Dog Training!

I chose Gabriel to train my new rescue, Scrappy, after reading quite literally hundreds of impressive five-star reviews across several platforms. After working with him, I can confidently say that those reviews were not an exaggeration.

We worked with Gabriel through both individual sessions in our home and board-and-train. From our very first meeting, it was obvious that his approach goes far beyond what others offer. Gabriel is a behaviorist who focuses on understanding the psychology and emotional state behind a dog’s behavior beyond simply teaching commands or correcting unwanted behaviors. One of the most impressive things about working with him is how quickly he can read a dog and understand what is actually driving their behavior.

Before choosing Gabriel, I met with several other trainers. They charged hundreds of dollars just to assess Scrappy, and those evaluations largely consisted of provoking reactions and then explaining how they could address the problems later in training. Gabriel took a completely different approach. Within seconds of meeting Scrappy, he was already working with him.  In the first session, Gabriel had my nervous little dog, who we had thought was possibly people and dog reactive, off-leash walking around with big dogs and welcoming greetings from their owners.

The board-and-train was also an excellent experience. I really appreciated knowing that Scrappy was not only receiving high-level training but was also being cared for by Gabriel and his family. It was clear that they made his well-being a priority, which gave me peace of mind while he was away.  Gabriel sent daily video updates.  Scrappy’s confidence, reactivity, resource guarding, impulse control, and recall all improved significantly during his time with Gabriel.

Just as importantly, Gabriel taught us how to continue the work at home. We definitely still have work to do on our end, but Gabriel gave us an excellent foundation and the tools to keep moving forward.

Gabriel is exceptionally committed to the dogs he works with. Even though we are not currently meeting regularly with him, he is available to answer follow-up questions and provide guidance when needed.  It is also clear that he wants the owners of the dogs he trains to be self-sufficient.

One thing that really stood out to me is how flexible and creative Gabriel is in his approach. It’s clear that his background in jazz has influenced the way he works—he’s incredibly adaptable, thinks on his feet, and seems to instinctively know when to change course based on what the dog is giving him in the moment. Nothing feels scripted or one-size-fits-all. He has a remarkable ability to improvise, problem-solve, and find the right approach in real time, which I think is a huge part of what makes him so effective.

Gabriel truly went above and beyond for Scrappy, and we couldn't have asked for a better experience. If you are looking for a trainer in the New York area who understands dogs on a deeper level and genuinely cares about their long-term success and well-being, I highly recommend Gabriel and Pawmos Training.

I found Gabriel by Googling "best dog trainer in NYC". He has over 100 five star reviews, and now I understand why. My dog, Money, spent some time at the shelter before I got him, and he was very leash reactive with other dogs. He also scavenges for food outside and could possibly eat something to make him sick.

Gabriel gave us very helpful tips to solve both of these issues, and then sent us an email recap of the things we need to do with him. We have been following his recommendations, and the difference in my dog is already incredible. We only me with him a week ago!

It is not training that relies on treats, special collars, or cruel methods. It is behavior modification that teaches dogs what the boundaries and rules are in a way that they understand. Definitely THE NYC Dog Whisperer. I cannot recommend him highly enough!

Gabriel was wonderful to work with, and we saw meaningful improvements in several of our puppy's behaviors after training.

Before working with Gabriel, our puppy would constantly try to eat things off the street and would nudge strangers on walks. Those behaviors have improved dramatically. He also has much more reliable recall now and comes back when called in off-leash areas.

Gabriel is knowledgeable, patient, and took the time to understand our puppy's personality as well as our goals. He was also responsive to follow-up questions after the training and offered practical advice as new challenges came up. The one area we're still continuing to work on is leash pulling. Our puppy is a large, strong dog (75+ lbs), and while we made progress in many other areas, he still gets very excited and pulls, especially when heading toward his favorite places like the dog park. Gabriel answered my questions about tools such as a gentle leash which has helped manage his strength while we continue reinforcing loose-leash walking.

Overall, we're very happy with our experience and would absolutely recommend Gabriel to anyone looking for a thoughtful, positive trainer who genuinely cares about helping both dogs and their owners succeed.

Upon meeting him, you can immediately tell that Gabriel takes a compassionate approach towards understanding dogs, and it shows in his work and results. My Frenchie, stubborn and hard-to-train as the rest of them, saw marked improvements after just one session with Gabriel. I highly recommend him to any owner of a dog with behavioral issues... just one meeting is all it takes!

Gabriel is a dog whisperer! Our pup's behavior improved almost immediately after working with Gabriel. He is an expert in his field, and since working with him, our dog no longer has signs of separation anxiety, and his basic obedience issues have improved dramatically. I highly recommend his services and would definitely go back for more training if needed.
Gabriel helped us work on some difficult issues with our new puppy, and it was a real game changer. Our puppy is much better adjusted and happier with the techniques we learned

Gabriel has unlocked some challenges I have been having with my leash reactive Doberman. He is very clear and concise and is able to use real examples and situations in public to address our needs. That way, I am able to practice on my own after our sessions.

It’s important to note Gabriel focuses on more dog behavioralist work which is different than a dog trainer that I had previously. We are able to allow my dog to go through the process and make the right decisions. That is the goal.

I strongly recommend Gabriel for any needs you may have with your dogs. You won’t regret it. Thank you !

Gabriel helped us to be patient with raising our puppy. We enjoyed his experience a lot and learned so much of the joys of raising a puppy is not just training the dog, it’s adjusting our own expectations. We and our puppy loved working with him!

Gabriel significantly improved our dog's ability to handle New York. When we got her, she wasn't able to walk on the leash. After just one session, she learned to love walking outside! Gabe's techniques have transformed how our dog lives her life, and we're extremely grateful.

We worked with Gabriel for both in-home training and board and train for our puppy, Max. Gabriel is an amazing trainer and really takes the time to explain his methods and why it works - we've learned so much! When Max came home from board and train he was like a new dog - we cannot thank Gabriel enough. I would recommend him to anyone and everyone looking for dog training.

Gabriel is absolutely amazing! He was incredibly helpful in helping us work through our dog Charlie's reactivity and helping her adjust to life in a city and apartment environment. He is so thoughtful and we are huge fans of his positive approach to training. There was never a moment that we didn't trust him with Charlie and I'm sure Charlie would say the same, if she could speak.

We worked with Gabriel for our puppy Walter. We both had Gabriel come to our house and had Walter board with Gabriel when we were out of town. Gabriel was our second trainer for our dog and he was so much better to work with. We joked that every time he came over, Walter was such an angel. The best part of working with Gabriel is that the tactics he uses are actually easy to reproduce on your own and are not a ton of work. They are easy and actionable and don't require a ton of time and effort.

Would highly recommend, we loved working with Gabriel.
We had an amazing experience with Gabriel. He is the best! We highly recommend!
Gabriel has an incredible and experienced understanding of dogs.  I got one session and got enough to work on for a year!

Gabriel was so kind, friendly, and AMAZING to work with! My pup Brody was instantly responsive to his training, and more importantly, I immediately felt 10x more confident and comfortable training Brody as a result of just one session. I also used some of Gabriel's Pawmos videos for "continued education" if you want to think of it that way; Pawmos was so helpful months later when Brody was regressing a bit and I was getting super discouraged! I would highly recommend Gabriel/Pawmos, especially if it's your first dog and you're not as confident as you'd like to be!

We could not have been luckier to find Gabriel. He started working with our puppy Annie when she was only 9 weeks old. He taught us how to crate train her within 2 days, and helped us with a schedule for potty training. We did board and train with him once she started leash walking and she came back the same sweet puppy but with infinitely more manners and a great walker in the busy (and sometimes gross) BK streets. What makes him so amazing is he doesn’t discipline but teaches the pups emotional regulation so they can settle in all situations and be happy, healthy dogs. We get comments constantly at how well adjusted and sweet our now 1 year old Annie is in all situations - big parties, stores, coffee shops, dog parks etc. and that’s all thanks to the foundation Gabriel set. We can’t recommend him enough!!

My wife and I adopted a crazy little chihuahua mix Taffy as a buddy for our gentle giant Pyrenees. We were unprepared for how high energy and protective Taffy became with my pregnant wife. Gabriel was a life-saver teaching us how to redirect Taffy's energy and focus with our other dog, with people at the door, with guests in our home, and especially on walks. Taffy has made enormous strides and continues to improve as we stay consistent with the strategies Gabriel taught us. If we're ever psychotic enough to get another puppy right before we have a child, my first call is going to be to Gabriel!
Gabriel is a dog whisperer. Skilled knowledgeable and kind! I can’t thank him enough for helping us overcome challenges with our Bella

Gabriel is an amazing trainer and we would recommend him to absolutely anyone.  We adopted a dog who became very reactive after his initial shyness and were completely flummoxed and incredibly stressed.  One session with Gabriel immediately gave us peace of mind.  Not only did he help train our dog, but he helped train us by giving us the skills to work with our dog ourselves.

I have followed up with Gabriel over multiple sessions because we had such a great experience with him.  Highly recommend!

Working with Gabriel has been incredibly helpful our first year with our puppy. He is  patient and informative for new dog owners and explains the rationale behind techniques in a way that is easy to understand and absorb. Would highly recommend!!

Simply put, Gabriel is a miracle worker. I adopted a dog, Tootsie, who I could not get to leave the house for 2 weeks, she was completely shut down with fear. He had her happily walking outside on the leash within 5 minutes of meeting her. His knowledge of dog behavior and ability to teach me the skills I needed to best support her. I highly, highly recommend his services to anyone looking for dog training.

Boarding our dog, Toast, with Gabriel for 2.5 weeks was the best decision we have made!

We completely trust Gabriel's gentle, positive reinforcement approach. Toast was happy, confident, and showed incredible improvements in recall and off-leash socialization almost immediately.

Gabriel also ensured our success at home by walking us through a detailed, step-by-step training plan when we picked Toast up. We have seen a huge improvement in Toast's behavior and cannot recommend Gabriel enough!

We've done one at-home session with Gabriel and he immediately understood what we needed to do to help our dog. The training is very simple and effective. Our dog is generally calmer and her resource guarding has improved tremendously. We will certainly be working with Gabriel in the future if we continue to need help!

Gabriel came over for a training session for our dog Pascal. He went over several techniques to help Pascal with his territorial nature. We spent at least an hour at the apartment teaching Pascal (and me). Then, we also went on a walk where he discussed more techniques for setting structure. Gabriel sent a very detailed follow-up email outlining everything we discussed and the details of the exercises we should work on. I've been working on the exercises with Pascal since, and have seen much improvement in Pascal's behavior!! We highly recommend Pawmos!

Gabriel saved us from insanity. We rescued our dog before realizing she had separation anxiety and would bark when left alone. We tried a trainer who specialized in separation anxiety training and worked with her for 2 months with little improvements. I am so grateful we found Gabriel, within a couple weeks after meeting with him we were able to leave our dog home alone for 2 hours. Now we can leave her alone for 4 hours. Before we found Gabriel we were seriously considering finding a new home for our dog where she would never have to be alone but I am so glad we didn't have to because we are so in love with her now and she has become so well behaved. Gabriel gave us our lives back and gave us the confidence to establish boundaries with our dog instead of letting her run our lives. Thank you for everything Gabriel. If you have a problem, I know he can fix it!

My son got Gracie, who is a pitti, as a rescue a year ago. She is a young strong dog, about 60lbs. My husband is retired and he watches her while my son works. We live in a large old Brooklyn apt building. The halls are narrow and the elevator can be full. There are times when Gracie will react strongly with some of the neighbors. This behavior is unpredictable. A lot of people don't like and are unfamiliar with dogs. They will stare at Gracie, and she is at 100 is ferocious. She is scary. That is a very uncomfortable and unwelcome situation and dangerous too. A dog like Gracie needs to be trained and we need to be trained too. We hired Gabriel to help us to understand how to work with Gracie. Over the year, we have had him come to our building and work with us 4x. It has been enormously helpful.  He has helped us to work on specific things, like distraction by way of side pulling with the leash (never pulling back!), breaking her concentration on the one person, that is causing Gracie to go ballistic, with a gentle side pull, a circle away from the stimulus and a sharp noise that get her attention away from the stimulus.  The goal is de escalate and it works! Having Gabriel work with us has helped us to gain the confidence necessary to work with our sweet charcoal gray Gracie. We will have come over again for a refresher session. Everyone needs a refresher. Our relationship with our dogs area always dynamic, never static, and a reminder of how to be with them is good thing. I really liked Gabriel!

We were SO happy to find Pawmos Dog Training. Our pup Bo is a big baby (silver Labrador) at over 100 lbs and just a year and change old. He had all sorts of issues from jumping up, leash pulling, barking and all the typically doggy issues. I knew he needed more than just a few sessions, so we booked him for a week long doggy sleep over/intervention. I love how communicative, enthusiastic, and patient Gabriel was with Bo and us. He returned home with so much more understanding of what we want from him and how to better behave. Of course there is no magic wand and we have to keep up the work, but he is significantly better and we look forward to having some follow up visits in the future. We HIGHLY recommend Pawmos Dog Training to anyone that needs help!

Great, knowledgeable and kind. Hisnsession was very informative, answered all out questions and I never once felt rushed during the session. The follow up email was just as informative as the session. Can not recommend enough.

Gabriel completely changed my life. If you’re reading this, I’m going to sound like a liar because it just sounds too good to be true. But I swear working with Gabriel was the best decision I ever made.

I have a 1yr old dachshund who was notoriously reactive. He barked at everything from bikes to other dogs to the wind blowing the wrong way. It was so bad that some days I couldn’t walk him more than 2ft outside our front door before he’s see something that would set him off and the day would be ruined. He could not go to dog parks. He could not meet other dogs on the street. He could not be around children. His behavior got him nicknamed “the lil devil” around the neighborhood and my in laws had asked us not to bring him to Christmas this year!

We tried training I had picked up from when my older dog went through training years prior. No use.  We tried a different trainer through another company. She was friendly and had us try positive reinforcement treat training while outside. But it did not help in the slightest. We tried for weeks and saw no improvement. I then tried every YouTube channel I could find on dog training and spent an hours outside with him at a time, seeing only very minimal improvement on occasion. I thought all hope was lost.

Then finally I decided to trust a review I found on Reddit for Pawmos. I signed up but expected little. Thankfully I was too quick to judge. After ONE session my dog was immediately more well behaved. Gabriel had us switch our leash and gave me pointers on how to communicate effectively with the leash and my dog. By the end of the 1hr session my dog was not only walking without pulling, he also met other dogs on the street, and went to the park where he played with other dogs both on and off leash!

I thought for sure it had to be a fluke. No way could one session solve 99% of my dogs problems. But I was wrong. I followed Gabriel’s advice and going on walks now is a breeze. My family can’t believe this is the same dog. I enjoy being a pet owner again. I’m able to take my dog into stores and to the dog park and walk around a very triggering city with almost no problems (he still has a few minor grumbles but it’s 0.0001% of the intensity as before and corrects himself quickly).

If you are at the end of your rope literally can’t figure out what else to do, the answer is pawmos. The cost of a session can’t even come close to the reward of having a well behaved dog.
Amazing training and super knowledgeable about dogs! My dog Oreo learned a lot during the training session and she is now less fearful when walking outside.

wow I read all of the reviews and everything was absolutely TRUE! My dog has been extremely fearful of going on walks because of fireworks, explosive construction noises, and any loud sounds really. We were struggling for months between consulting the vets, trying different medications, and  trying different training methods. Within not even 10 mins of assessing our girl, Gabriel was able to get her calm enough to walk past all her usual thresholds. We are so excited to continue utilizing the techniques he taught us and see her progress. For the first time, we are feeling hopeful that we can enjoy walks and the outdoors with our dog again. Such a great experience and highly recommend Pawmos!!
Super professional and truly has a gift for communicating and working with dogs. It's amazing how much value we got out of a single session with him. Looking forward to booking again.

Another 5 star review for Gabriel, the most incredible dog trainer my husband or I have ever consulted with in my entire life of dog ownership. He completely reframes how you think about dog training, from the basis of behavioral training frameworks vs.  obedience training, which is the more commonly taught approach.

He helped us understand the mind and motivations of our Boston Terrier and how to communicate a consistence presence of calm using the leash as a tool even in the home (that will eventually no longer be needed). We're working on pulling during walks (fixed IMMEDIATELY btw) and more so barking when the doorbell rings, people knock, or folks come over. The latter will take some time, but already seeing improvements in the frequency and intensity of our pup's responses to those stimuli.

Gabriel is premium in price, but the value, quality, and content of his sessions, plus his obvious goal to empower you with the information and tools you need to succeed, make him a no-brainer worthwhile investment for you and your pup.

We can’t recommend Pawmos and Gabriel enough. From the start, it was clear he’s not only super knowledgeable but also incredibly kind and empathetic. His calm, thoughtful approach made a huge difference right away. Some of the bad habits we’d been dealing with for months were basically corrected after our first session.

What really stands out is how quickly Gabriel was able to understand our dog and explain exactly what we needed to do. Nothing felt overwhelming or unrealistic. His training is effective and grounded in real experience, not gimmicks.

Our dog is more focused and relaxed, and we feel more confident about how to develop better behaviors going forward. If you’re looking for someone who truly knows what they’re doing and actually gets results, Gabriel/Pawmos are the best choice.

We’d recommend him to anyone looking for effective, thoughtful dog training. Thank you, Gabriel!!
Gabriel is pretty amazing. My dog and I are even happier together thanks to his great care and understanding. HIGHLY recommend!

So glad we reached out to Gabriel! Our dog, Miso, was struggling with leash reactivity and nervousness around strangers, a combination that was sometimes stressful in a place like NY. Gabriel was able to analyze and provide simple, intuitive methods for us to help Miso learn to stay calm and rebuild her confidence. We had two sessions and Gabriel was so great at really listening to our experiences, providing achievable strategies, and then walking us through these in situ, whether it was on the street or at a dog run, so we could practice it with him. Thank you so much, Miso is doing great!

If you need help with your pup, look no further - Gabriel is truly something special. Our puppy Remi had real issues walking on a leash when other dogs are present due to his extreme excitement - something truly difficult to control in NYC, where there are dogs walking outside pretty much at all times! When Remi would see a dog, he would either pull hard towards the dog or simply plant his feet and fixate. This made walking outside extremely difficult, and we worried that over time this behavior could lead to aggression. We didn’t think we would see a result after one session but Gabriel had Remi walking by other dogs with no tension on the leash within minutes of stepping outside! Gabriel did a wonderful job explaining the difference between training and behavior, teaching us how to communicate non-verbally through leash pressure, and showing us how to properly de-escalate Remi’s excitement around other dogs to produce a long-lasting change in his behavior.

From that one session, he gave us concrete strategies to implement when approaching a dog on the street, and showed us how to break Remi’s fixation, which immediately helped in resolving our walking issue. It has been about a month since our session with Gabriel and Remi is doing SO much better! By consistently applying Gabriel’s advice, we have seen a gradual but definite change in Remi’s behavior around dogs. He is able to be calm around other dogs. We are correcting him far less overall, and he is able to walk by other dogs with a lot of ease! Not perfect, but a true change in behavior takes time, and we are a lot more confident now thanks to Gabriel’s guidance. Book your session!!
